verdicts.reason: A keeps the three flavour chips together in one row, but it stacks the SOLSTICE wordmark under the headline, squeezes the subline into tiny two-line text beside the chips, and pushes the CTA tight against the right edge. B keeps the headline, brand and subline block clean, but its chips are scattered at odd sizes over the decorative circles on the left (Honey Rosemary sits on a circle), so they look broken. B's scatter is the worse flaw.

A has a cramped subline next to the chips, the brand sits below the headline, and the CTA is crowded at the edge, but it has a clear hierarchy and a prominent CTA. B breaks the chip group apart (Cucumber Mint alone on the left, the other two stacked on the right) and shrinks Shop Flavours to chip size in that stack, which buries the CTA.
